newsitem.title: USA: INSIGHT - Retest of 115.70 key for shaky dlr/yen.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Retest of 115.70 key for shaky dlr/yen.

text.p: A sharp overseas drop left dollar/yen on shaky footing on Wednesday, making a near-term retest of its June 12th 115.70 high key for any bullish upturn, technical anaylsts said.
"The 115.65/75 area is the key area now," said Scott Siller, senior technical analyst at MCM MoneyWatch. "That is where the stops are hiding."
The dollar rose as high as 115.65 yen on Monday, but by late afternoon on Wednesday it was trading below the 114 threshold.

Chartists pegged solid support near 113.30, with a stronger prop around the 112.80/85 area. Barring a move back to the 115.70 level, however, they said they could not rule out a return dollar/yen's recent 110.60/65 low.
"The bottom line is I'm still bearish dollar/yen especially in the wake of Monday's unsuccessful test of resistance at 115.70," said Pete Grant, senior foreign exchange analyst at MMS International.
Grant said dollar/mark could ultimately follow dollar/yen lower. He pegged initial support at 1.7150 and said a move below there would bring the June 9 low of 1.7030 into play.

"Once we get below that I'll feel pretty comfortable calling for a retest of the critical supports of 1.6680 and 1.6615," said Grant. "Those are the levels that have to be negated to confirm my dollar topping scenario."
